claims.text: Atherosclerotic stroke w LDL ≥ 100 mg/dL: statin (atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, simvastatin, pravastatin).
claims.quote: Statin therapy (atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, simvastatin, pravastatin) is recommended for patients with evidence of atherosclerotic stroke and LDL (low-density lipoprotein) cholesterol ≥ 100 mg/dL.
A reasonable LDL cholesterol target is a 50% reduction or a level of < 70 mg/dL.
